import { Aside } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

## Images

Every image is built from the monorepo root, because each needs
`packages/db` as well as its app:

```sh
docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t shop-api .
docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile --target migrate -t shop-api-migrate .
docker build -f apps/worker/Dockerfile -t shop-worker .
```

Each Dockerfile runs `turbo prune <app> --docker` first: the install layer is
built from that app's manifests and a pruned lockfile, so it is reused until a
dependency the app actually uses changes. The build stage runs
`turbo run build --filter=<app>`, which builds `@scope/db` first, and the
runtime stage keeps production dependencies only.

| Image | Runs | Port |
|---|---|---|
| `shop-api` | `node dist/src/main` in `apps/api` | 5000 |
| `shop-api-migrate` | `prisma migrate deploy` against `$DATABASE_URL`, then exits | none |
| `shop-worker` | `pm2-runtime` (or `node`, without `worker-pm2`) in `apps/worker` | none |

<Aside title="The runtime stage copies packages/db">
`node_modules/@scope/db` is a symlink to `packages/db`, so the runtime image
keeps `packages/db/package.json` and `dist/` at the same relative path. A
Dockerfile you write for another app needs the same two copies.
</Aside>

## Deploying

1. Run `shop-api-migrate:<tag>` once, with the production `DATABASE_URL`.
2. Start `shop-api:<tag>` and `shop-worker:<tag>`.

Deploy every app on the **same tag**. They share one Prisma client, so an API
and a worker from different commits can disagree about the schema.

Everything else, the API's variables and health checks, the worker's process
model and Chromium, is as in [nest-api](../../nest-api/deployment/) and
[node-worker](../../node-worker/deployment/).

## CI

`.forgejo/workflows/` at the root:

| Workflow | Runs on | Does |
|---|---|---|
| `ci.yml` | every branch except `main` and `development` | `turbo run lint typecheck test build` |
| `test-e2e.yml` | pull requests into `development` | the API's e2e suite against service containers |
| `build-and-push.yml` | `main`, manual runs | builds every image and pushes them under one shared tag |
